name: laid-to-rest
about: Hill-climb reproduction of Lamb of God — Laid to Rest (Ashes of the Wake, 2004), from Songsterr tab 12062 (all parts), aligned to the official video's audio (the album mix). Generated by tools/tab2song.py from tools/maps/laid-to-rest.json, then hand-tuned.

ltr-lead.about: Laid to Rest's copy of chirp-config patches/m8-lead.yaml as of v21 (inlined so the song does not change when the shared copy does). Fluid, saturated legato lead (Thordendal-ish) with delayed vibrato, ping-pong delay and a big room.
fx: delay time=3/16 mix=0.25 feedback=0.4 ping_pong=true tone=3k

ltr-rhythm-l.about: Laid to Rest's copy of chirp-config patches/m8-rhythm-l.yaml as of v21 (inlined so the song does not change when the shared copy does). Left rhythm rig for double-tracked heavy riffs: the 8-string into a 5150-voiced amp with a screamer, cookie-monster/kitten-slayer cab blend, fizz dip and high shelf, a short plate. Pair with m8-rhythm-r on the right (different rig, pick and seed) for a real double.
ltr-rhythm-l.extends: m8 layers.0.pick=0.12 layers.0.pickup=0.09 layers.0.click=0.2 layers.0.scrape=0.12 layers.0.thump=expr.pm*0.7 layers.0.squeak=expr.move*0.6

ltr-rhythm-r.about: Laid to Rest's copy of chirp-config patches/m8-rhythm-r.yaml as of v21 (inlined so the song does not change when the shared copy does). Right rhythm rig for double-tracked heavy riffs: a different player and rig from m8-rhythm-l — pick nearer the neck, other pickup/coil and string stiffness, Gojira-voiced amp, darth-genocider/cookie-monster cab blend, its own fizz dip, short plate. Give the right track its own seed and ~9 ms humanize.
ltr-rhythm-r.extends: m8 layers.0.pick=0.095 layers.0.pickup=0.1 layers.0.coil=0.36 layers.0.stiff=0.29 layers.0.click=0.2 layers.0.scrape=0.12 layers.0.thump=expr.pm*0.7 layers.0.squeak=expr.move*0.6
